artworks.title: Poseidon of Melos
artworks.description: Hellenistic marble statue of Poseidon found on the island of Melos, now in the National Archaeological Museum, Athens. The sea god stands in a commanding pose, his raised right hand once gripping a trident, with a dolphin at his feet supporting the figure.

artworks.title: Neptune and Triton
artworks.description: Early marble group by Gian Lorenzo Bernini, carved to crown a garden fountain in Rome and now in the Victoria and Albert Museum, London. Neptune thrusts his trident downward to command the waters while the young Triton crouches between his legs, blowing a conch shell.
